findings.what: No `test` script; `npm test` fails with 'Missing script: test'. Suite (48 tests) only passes via `node --test 'tests/*.test.mjs'`; `node --test tests/` errors with MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
No page or layout links to /tentang-kami; the About page is unreachable by visitors navigating the site.
saveContactMessage is not wrapped in try/catch; a DB failure throws to the error boundary, losing the visitor's input with no friendly error.
Scaffold metadata 'Create Next App' left in place and lang='en' on Indonesian content.
SQLite DB written to data/app.db, which is not gitignored; visitor PII could be committed.
Length limits use UTF-16 .length, so non-BMP characters (emoji) count double against the 100/2000 limits.
Opens the DB, runs CREATE TABLE and closes it on every submit; inefficient.
Kontak page has no navigation back to Beranda.
